Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects.  For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.
Card Q&A.q: What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can be chosen.  For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can.  It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect.  However, if an effect such as  is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?

Card Q&A.a: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.
Card Q&A.q: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?

Card Q&A.a: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.
Card Q&A.q: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?

Card Q&A.a: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.
Card Q&A.q: A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking].  Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?

Effect: When this card would be played, if there are 2 or more suspended Digimon, reduce the cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend up to 2 Digimon. Then, none of your suspended [Vegetation] or [TS] trait Digimon are affected by your opponent's Digimon effects until their turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any Digimon suspend, to 1 of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP until their turn ends for each suspended Digimon.
